crop.notes: First paragraph is the Allen item; the second paragraph (boys throwing stones at Bellefontaine cars) is unrelated. Clipping is faded but readable.

ocr.notes: Gist is there; many character errors ('pugiiive law', 'viende', 'trinl').

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican, citing the New York Sun, reported that the Farrell brothers' property near Covington, Ky., was levied on for Allen's $3,000 bail bond after he fled to Canada instead of standing trial for the Goss fight.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Monday Morning, March 26, 1877, page 8. Filed as the Missouri Republican before 1888.

facts.fact: The property of the Farrell brothers near Covington, Kentucky, was levied on to satisfy Allen's $3,000 bail bond; they had been sureties for his return to stand trial for the prize fight with Joe Goss
Allen was reported to have fled to Canada rather than stand trial in Kentucky for the Goss fight

notes: Secondhand from the New York Sun. The item is entirely about Allen, so focus is raised to primary.
